evidence.observation: Exhaust oxygen and tube pressure sensors are not installed; purge effectiveness and growth atmosphere/pressure cannot be verified.
Thermocouple reads 749.6 °C against a 750.0 °C growth setpoint.
Argon flow reads 100.1 sccm against a 100.0 sccm setpoint.
Heater power is 44.8% and controller reports running; these do not establish atmosphere integrity.

args.missing_evidence: Independent tube pressure and exhaust oxygen measurements are needed to verify the growth environment and purge effectiveness; sample characterization is needed to determine whether the target material grew.
